```{R}
library(tidyverse)
```
# Bank data: customer 
```{R}
# Create bank customer info data
customer <- tibble(customer_id = c("C120463", "N4244552", "A907892", "Z337572", "D701453", "A
285883"),
names = c("John", "Sam", "Mike", "Rachael", "Mary", "Will"),
sex = c("M", "F", "M", "F", "F", "M"),
educ = c("HS", "Bachelor", "PhD", "Bachelor", "HS", "HS"),
wage = c(1200, 900, 3100, 600, 500, 800))
# Print customer
customer
```

Bank data: transaction 
```{R}
# Create bank spending transaction data
transaction <- tibble(customer_id = c("D701453", "N4244552", "C120463", "A907892", "D701453", 
"C120463", "N4244552", "C120463", "A907892"),
shop = c("JB Hifi", "Steakhouse", "Apple", "Coles", "Lobster Diner", "D
ymocks", "Target", "Netflix", "Mecca"),
amount = c(300, 110, 3000, 80, 185, 40, 25, 15, 170)) 
# Print transaction
transaction
```

# Left join customer into transaction 
```{R}
transaction_customer <- left_join(transaction, customer, by = "customer_id")

transaction_customer
```

# Bar chart of the average amount spent by education levels
```{R}
transaction_customer %>% 
  group_by(educ) %>%
  summarise(avg_amount = mean(amount)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = educ, y = avg_amount)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  labs(title = "Average spending by education level", x = " Education", y = "Average transaction amount")
```

# Left join of customer into transaction produces a joined data set that differs from a left join of transaction into customer 
```{R}
customer %>% left_join(transaction, by = "customer_id")
```

# Bank data: inner join 
```{R}
customer %>% inner_join(transaction, by = "customer_id")
```

# Create FAANG data
```{R}
# Create data of 2019 FAANG revenue
FAANG <- tibble(company = c("Facebook", "Amazon", "Apple", "Netflix", "Alphabet (formerly Goo
gle)"),
revenue_billion = c(70.7, 280.5, 260.2, 20.16, 161.86)) 
# Print FAANG
FAANG
```
# Inner join transaction and FAANG by shop = company
```{R}
transaction %>% inner_join(FAANG, by = c("shop" = "company"))
```

# Joining data from nycflights13
```{R}
# Load nycflights13
library(nycflights13)

# Head of flights
head(flights)

# Head of airlines
head(airlines)

# Head of airports
head(airports)
```

# Left join airlines into flights 
```{R}
flights %>% left_join(airlines, by = "carrier")
```

# Left join airports into flights
```{R}
flights %>% left_join(airports, by = c("origin" = "faa"))
```
